name: Arshdeep Dubey
headline: Ex-Software Engineer II @ Fidelity International | Major in AI @ IIT Ropar
about: Ex-Software Engineer at Fidelity International. Engineered production-grade financial microservices, migrating workloads from legacy Unix servers to Amazon EKS. Built 20+ SnapLogic pipelines with logging and traceability to support data delivery and faster root-cause analysis. Managed end-to-end migration of multiple projects from on-premise Nexus to Cloud Nexus. Built infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines using Terraform and Jenkins. Maintained high system availability and met critical SLAs during peak business hours. Strong foundation in data structures and algorithms, system design, and Agile methodologies, with working knowledge of artificial intelligence and neural networks.

experience.title: Software Engineer II
highlights: Owned the cross-cutting ELK Observability Epic across 14 cloud microservices; standardized custom JSON logging schemas and Kibana dashboards to optimize telemetry tracking, boosting log traceability by 30% and reducing production incident MTTR by 40%.

Engineered automated pipeline and secret-creation workflows in Terraform, AWS Secrets Manager, and Jenkins while establishing GitOps workflows with Helm, ArgoCD, and Docker to decouple code/config, cutting deployment overhead by 30%.

Architected enterprise data routing and ODS Data Lifecycle Pipelines using Java, SnapLogic, and Terraform to automate data archival, normalisation, and retrieval across AWS RDS, S3, and Glacier, optimizing cloud storage costs while enforcing strict compliance SLAs.

experience.title: Software Engineer
highlights: Solely engineered and deployed 20+ production data transformation and ETL pipelines in SnapLogic for cloud migration, authoring 10+ reusable pipeline templates adopted portfolio-wide that enhanced engineering team productivity by 75%.

Developed high-throughput Java/Spring Boot data connectors and streaming endpoints (REST-to-S3, DB-to-S3) processing over 10,000 million records daily, while managing production deployments and on-call rotations to consistently maintain strict SLA targets.

Implemented Zero-Trust cloud security modules in Terraform, automating secret lifecycle management in AWS Secrets Manager, CyberArk certificate renewals, and cross-account IRSA roles for EKS workloads.

experience.title: Associate Software Engineer
highlights: Developed a full-stack travel booking platform from scratch using Spring Boot, Maven, Thymeleaf, and MongoDB, and contributed to a Node.js NFT minting bot for automated, decentralized voucher distribution.

Integrated Microsoft Graph API with OAuth 2.0 and SMTP authentication to engineer an automated organizational messaging engine, eliminating 2–3 days of auth integration boilerplate and maintaining high platform uptime.

experience.title: Computer Vision Research Intern
highlights: Developed real-time noise-reduction pipelines for live image and video streams using Python, OpenCV, and Spyder IDE.
Applied Gaussian blur and spatial filtering to suppress sensor noise and improve visual frame quality for automated detection systems.

Worked on image-processing techniques relevant to surveillance monitoring, autonomous-vehicle vision, and industrial quality inspection, including low-latency object tracking and edge detection in changing lighting conditions.
